purpose: Prospective frozen FINAL conditional-SC component comparison; does not evaluate unrestricted rotation or SFP
readiness_gate: All eleven persistent32v1 cases must pass unchanged geometry/contact and complete 2000 Hz force audit, correct jitter/load provenance, one sensor publisher, harness v20 and matching source/checkpoint hashes
conditions: Prescribed rigid grasp; nominal upstream connector angular alignment; translation and in-hand grasp are estimated from actual RGB
old_100000_series: Untouched; belongs to the earlier broader/full-angle protocol, not relabeled as this conditional task

sampling.grasp_jitter: Independent Bernoulli(0.5); source generator uniform +/-2mm translation and +/-0.04rad xyz Euler components

source_and_checkpoint_lock: Must match the qualifying development version before final start; every trial aborts if frozen sources change
setup_failures: Preserve and report separately; also report all-selected and policy-eligible denominators, never silently replace cases
initial_pose_diagnostics: Report actual initial angle/offset; do not filter cases post-hoc by final success conditions
force: Raw independent wrist FT at every 0.5ms physics step (SDF unthrottled rate 0); no missing step allowed by strict coverage audit; <=8 N measured raw peak required in addition to unchanged geometric/contact scoring. The 50 Hz policy abort cannot guarantee a physical force ceiling.
statistics: Wilson 95% intervals per method; three prespecified paired exact two-sided McNemar tests versus full method with Holm correction; all-selected and measurement-eligible denominators, no post-hoc replacements
timing: Separate policy simulation/wall times; run without concurrent owned training or inference audits
publication_status: No submission or claim of novelty/hardware generalization follows automatically from this experiment
whole_trial_penetration_scope: Maximum observed from recorded 100 Hz contact stream, not a proven every-step penetration bound
original_final31_status: Readiness failed at 9/10; no final31 cases ever opened. This revised source-frozen study uses additional force measurement and braking controls.
